about: Real-data geo cases. Expected values come from tests/oracle/geo.py (the Python reference), regenerated with `python3 -I tests/oracle/geo.py --write`. D is POD.data with the fixture tiles from tests/fixtures/stores/ in D.TILES: all of them unless the case lists `tiles`. `tileRun` replaces a tile's run id. Unrounded distances compare with a relative tolerance of 1e-9.
